Bug_Title: MF: Method defines a variable that obscures a field (MF_METHOD_MASKS_FIELD)
Bug_Details:
This method defines a local variable with the same name as a field
in this class or a superclass.  This may cause the method to
read an uninitialized value from the field, leave the field uninitialized,
or both.
Bug_Explanation: The method 'showBug' declares a local variable 'value' which has the same name as the field 'value'. This causes the field to be masked by the local variable, leading to potential confusion and incorrect use of values.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case 'testShowBug' triggers the bug by calling the method 'showBug' with an input of 5. Due to the variable masking bug, the method returns the local variable 'value' instead of the field 'value'. The test expects the field value 10, but the test fails because the method returns 5, demonstrating the bug.
